name: AXISCADES Technologies Limited
remarksWeb: 1.The Promoter Company, Tayana Digital Private Limited (TDPL), was merged with Promoter Group Company Jupiter Capital Private Limited (JC) with effect from 17th October, 2018. As a result of the merger, Jupiter Capital Private Limited is now the Promoter of the Company. The same was intimated by the company to the Stock exchange on 18 October 2018.   Until quarter ended March 2021, underlying shares continued to be held in the name of Tayana Digital Private Company (TDPL) with the depository. For the forthcoming quarters, the shares have been updated in the name of Promoter Company- Jupiter Capital Private Limited in the records of the depository..   Accordingly, the shareholding and the pledged shares as were appearing in TDPL until 31.03.2021, are shown under JC from quarter ending 30.06.2021.   2.
